The structure of SrZnCl₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42d (No. 38), with a unit cell of Sr₄Zn₄Cl₁₂ and 20 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for all centers: Cl and Zn each have six geometric neighbors, while Sr has six Cl neighbors, with Zn–Cl distances of 2.6233 Å and Sr–Cl distances of 2.8402 Å. The resulting geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include edge-sharing between Cl-centered octahedra and between Zn-centered octahedra.
